description: Twenty teams ranked 27-46 played home-and-away over two legs. Ten winners advanced to Round 2.
Thirty-six teams were split into nine groups of four. Group winners and runners-up advanced to Round 3.
Eighteen teams were split into three groups of six. Top two in each group qualified for the World Cup; third/fourth went to Round 4.
Six teams were split into two centralized groups of three. Group winners qualified; runners-up advanced to Round 5.
The fourth-round group runners-up played over two legs for AFC's inter-confederation playoff place.
Iraq entered the FIFA Play-Off Tournament and beat Bolivia 2-1 to secure the final World Cup berth.

Nine groups. Group winners qualified directly for the 2026 World Cup; the four best runners-up advanced to the CAF playoff. Matches against sixth-place teams were excluded when ranking runners-up because Group E had five active teams after Eritrea withdrew.
The four best runners-up played single-elimination matches in Morocco. DR Congo won and advanced to the inter-confederation playoffs.
CAF playoff winner DR Congo entered the FIFA inter-confederation playoff tournament and qualified by defeating Jamaica after extra time.
Canada, Mexico, and the United States qualified automatically as co-hosts.
Bottom four CONCACAF entrants played two-legged ties. Winners advanced to the second round.
Thirty teams in six groups of five. Each team played four matches. Group winners and runners-up advanced to the third round.
Twelve teams in three groups of four played home-and-away. Group winners qualified for the World Cup; two best runners-up advanced to the inter-confederation playoffs.
Jamaica and Suriname entered FIFA inter-confederation play-offs. Both were eliminated; no additional CONCACAF teams qualified through the playoff tournament.
Single 10-team double round-robin. Top six qualified directly for the World Cup; seventh advanced to the inter-confederation playoff.
Bolivia, the seventh-place CONMEBOL team, entered the inter-confederation playoff. Bolivia beat Suriname in a semi-final and lost to Iraq in the final.
Four lowest-ranked teams played a three-match knockout round in Samoa. Samoa won the final and advanced to Round Two.
Samoa joined the seven highest-ranked teams in two four-team groups. The top two teams in each group advanced to the Third Round.
Four-team knockout round in New Zealand. New Zealand won the final and qualified directly for the World Cup. New Caledonia advanced to the inter-confederation playoff.
OFC runner-up New Caledonia entered the FIFA World Cup 2026 Play-Off Tournament and lost 1-0 to Jamaica in the semifinal.

Twelve groups: six groups of four and six groups of five. Teams played home-and-away. Group winners qualified directly; group runners-up advanced to play-offs; four Nations League group winners outside the top two also advanced.
Sixteen teams entered four single-leg play-off paths. Each path had two semi-finals and one final. The four final winners qualified for the World Cup.
